hypothesis: Replace only uniform occupied-cell parent sampling with archive-progress-weighted sampling: give each source cell task-local binary credit when an evaluated descendant inserts into an empty cell or strictly improves an occupied cell, then mix its smoothed empirical progress rate with a fixed uniform exploration component so productive cells receive more parent draws while every occupied cell remains eligible.
method_thesis: For each independent objective session, place only the ten fixed oracle-evaluated starting molecules into a fresh MAP-Elites archive whose cells are a small fixed centroidal Voronoi tessellation of task-agnostic RDKit physicochemical descriptors. Draw occupied cells rather than globally ranked molecules, use their evaluated elites as parents for sanitized molecular-graph crossover and positional analogue mutation, and submit only novel valid offspring constructed de novo. After oracle feedback, map each accepted offspring to its descriptor cell and replace that cell's occupant only when the returned score is higher. Cell-local competition preserves structurally different stepping stones that a single global elite population would discard, while every cell still optimizes the same task reward and the global incumbent across the archive remains the sole terminal Top-1 target. The unlabeled corpus may define descriptor ranges or mutation fragments but is never scored, retrieved, ranked, or treated as a candidate pool; archive coverage and diversity are mechanism evidence rather than benchmark objectives.

method_tags.acquisition_mechanism: uniform occupied-cell emission and score competition against the incumbent of the offspring's own cell
method_tags.learning_mechanism: training-free within-niche elitist archive replacement driven only by returned oracle scores
method_tags.proposal_mechanism: niche-balanced selection of oracle-evaluated cell elites followed by de novo graph crossover and positional analogue mutation
method_tags.representation: RDKit molecular graphs indexed by a fixed CVT over task-agnostic physicochemical descriptors

activation_observables.measurement: For every parent draw, record each occupied cell's pre-draw fractional trial count, fractional binary archive-progress credit, smoothed progress rate q_i, declared probability p_i, and uniform probability 1/K, plus the selected cell. Reconstruct every q_i and p_i from prior accepted-offspring provenance and decisions, then on draws where the q_i values are non-identical report sum_i(p_i*q_i) minus sum_i(q_i)/K, the total-variation distance from uniform, the minimum p_i/(1/K) exploration ratio, and the realized draw counts. Aggregate the signed allocation lift across eligible draws relative to n-9ee8f4c3d8e6, whose exactly uniform policy has lift 0; activation requires exact formula reconstruction, positive pooled lift after histories diverge, and a minimum exploration ratio of at least 0.5.

applicability_conditions: Accepted offspring retain exact source-cell provenance and strict local archive decisions, so one task-local archive-progress outcome can be attributed without a surrogate or cross-session state.
Different occupied cells develop distinguishable descendant progress rates early enough in the 29 adaptive rounds for feedback-weighted allocation to affect later proposals.

Recent cumulative source-cell productivity is informative about future empty-cell insertions or positive local replacements under the unchanged graph operators; benefit may vanish when all niches are equally productive or productivity reverses faster than the smoothed counts can adapt.

Useful objective progress is correlated with continued archive coverage or strict within-cell improvement, rather than requiring repeated failures from a currently unproductive niche before a rare structural jump.

The fixed 0.5 uniform mixture is sufficient to keep low-history and lower-global-rank cell elites reachable; the mechanism may underperform when nearly uniform allocation is itself necessary to discover a very sparse delayed-payoff path.

The Parent's high canonical novel-valid graph-offspring yield and frozen descriptor assignment continue to hold, because this Child changes allocation among existing cell elites rather than candidate support or niche definitions.
Evidence for the bottleneck is limited to screening seed 0, so multi-seed stability and whether allocation lift mediates a reliable score gain remain to be established by the protocol evaluation.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism did not happen if any post-feedback draw with non-identical smoothed source-cell progress rates fails to use probabilities reproducibly equal to 0.5/K+0.5*q_i/sum_j(q_j), if its archive-progress-weighted allocation lift is non-positive, or if any occupied cell receives less than half its uniform-reference probability. If source-cell histories never become non-identical, activation is inconclusive because the feedback signal supplied no basis to depart from the Parent's uniform policy.
research_intent.implementation_change: Preserve the Parent's frozen CVT artifact and assignment, one-incumbent-per-cell archive, strict target-cell-only replacement, graph crossover and mutation portfolio, canonicalization and duplicate rejection, accepted-feedback matching, full-batch requirement, and all session boundaries. Add fresh per-objective fractional trial and archive-progress credit totals keyed only by source cell. For each accepted offspring, split one trial equally across its distinct provenance parent cells and, if its recorded decision is empty_insert or replace_higher, split one binary progress credit equally across those same cells; rejected local competitors contribute a trial and zero credit. Before each parent draw over K occupied cells, compute q_i=(credit_i+1)/(trial_i+2), including q_i=1/2 for a newly occupied cell, and declare p_i=0.5/K+0.5*q_i/sum_j(q_j); sample once from those probabilities with the existing seeded RNG. Log the complete pre-draw trial, credit, q_i, uniform reference, p_i, selected cell, and the feedback events that update credit. Do not use global score rank, remove any archive member, alter graph generation, or transfer credit between objective sessions.
research_intent.mechanism: Replace only uniform occupied-cell parent sampling with archive-progress-weighted sampling: give each source cell task-local binary credit when an evaluated descendant inserts into an empty cell or strictly improves an occupied cell, then mix its smoothed empirical progress rate with a fixed uniform exploration component so productive cells receive more parent draws while every occupied cell remains eligible.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Parent node n-9ee8f4c3d8e6 makes every one of its 2,207 occupied-cell parent draws exactly uniform, so its selection policy cannot use accumulated evidence that some descriptor cells' descendants are currently more productive than others. The emitter is not the limiting behavior: it produced 1,450 novel valid proposals from 1,503 graph-operator attempts and filled every batch, while the archive reached 76 of 80 task-local cells. Yet only 332 of 1,409 occupied-cell collisions made a strictly positive local replacement, 1,077 were rejected as non-higher, and the seed-0 final Top-1 values remained 0.1895644065926511 on median_2 and 0.21007735497596944 on sitagliptin_mpo. With only 29 adaptive rounds, continuing to allocate equal probability after source-cell outcomes diverge can spend late oracle calls on repeatedly unproductive niches instead of exploiting niches that are still creating coverage or local-quality progress.

applicability_conditions: Exact task-local attribution is supported here: all 1,450 accepted offspring had nonempty source-cell provenance, every logged fractional update replayed from that provenance and the recorded local decision, and each task independently started with zero trial and credit state before accumulating exactly 290 trial units.

The required heterogeneity arose early enough to act: all five tasks had identical zero-history rates only in generation 1, and every one of their later parent draws had non-identical q_i values and used the registered feedback mixture.

The fixed exploration component was sufficient under the observed histories: every occupied cell remained assigned positive probability and the minimum probability relative to uniform was 0.641408426301914, safely above the registered 0.5 bound even though q_i ranged from 0.08333333333333333 to 0.8.

The inherited frozen-assignment and graph-emitter conditions remained operational. Candidate and Parent used the same prepared CVT content hash; the Candidate filled all 145 ten-molecule adaptive batches, emitted 1,450 novel valid offspring from 1,513 graph-operator attempts (yield 0.9583608724388631), and completed all five 300-call sessions with zero evaluator-level invalid or duplicate attempts.

Evidence does not support the stronger utility condition that recent cumulative binary archive productivity predicts terminal objective progress. Candidate final archive occupancy totaled 73 of 80 task-local cells versus the Parent's 76, it recorded 360 binary progress decisions versus the Parent's 373, and its seed-0 final Top-1 was lower on every task despite confirmed positive allocation lift.

Applicability is established only for this batch-10, 29-adaptive-round, seed-0 replica with exact accepted-feedback provenance. It is not established when progress rates reverse faster than cumulative smoothing, useful improvements require repeated failures from a low-rate niche, or nearly uniform exploration is necessary for a sparse delayed-payoff path.

observable_measurements.value: Seed 0 across all five tasks contains 145 suggestion rounds and 2,224 occupied-cell parent draws, with 30,251 complete pre-draw cell-state rows. Independently replaying all 1,450 accepted-offspring feedback events from their distinct source-cell provenance and strict local decisions reproduced all 2,078 fractional update rows with zero discrepancies: each offspring contributed total trial mass 1, split as 1 or 1/2 across one or two distinct source cells, and each of the 38 empty insertions plus 322 strict local replacements contributed total binary credit 1 while all 1,090 non-higher decisions contributed zero. Final task-local trial totals were 290 on every task and pooled trial and credit totals were 1,450 and 360. Reconstructing q_i=(credit_i+1)/(trial_i+2), 1/K, and p_i=0.5/K+0.5*q_i/sum_j(q_j) from only the preceding feedback reproduced every recorded value on every draw with maximum absolute residual 0.0; probability normalization residual was at most 3.3306690738754696e-16. The 75 generation-1 draws had identical zero-history q_i=0.5. Histories were non-identical on every one of the 2,149 post-feedback draws, and all 2,149 had strictly positive allocation lift. Pooled signed lift was 32.6234299651124, with arithmetic mean 0.01518074916943341 and range 0.004241196683164028 to 0.02842038513098144. By task, eligible-draw count, lift sum, and lift mean were deco_hop 434, 7.141892754063231, 0.016455974087703298; drd2_docking 420, 9.032104394481934, 0.021505010463052223; median_2 437, 4.929300875214536, 0.011279864703008092; sitagliptin_mpo 440, 6.317065717348987, 0.014356967539429515; and zaleplon_mpo 418, 5.203066224003713, 0.012447526851683524. Across eligible draws q_i ranged from 0.08333333333333333 to 0.8, declared p_i from 0.04008802664386962 to 0.13790849673202615, and total variation from uniform had pooled mean 0.058343289027657196 and range 0.0232886751102824 to 0.08498009866903897. The minimum p_i/(1/K) exploration ratio was 0.641408426301914, above the registered 0.5 floor. Aggregate realized selected-cell counts were {0:139, 1:151, 2:159, 3:104, 4:201, 5:188, 6:159, 7:174, 8:180, 9:185, 10:146, 11:67, 12:80, 13:132, 14:120, 15:39}. Thus feedback changed allocation in the predicted direction on every eligible draw while preserving exploration.

possible_failure_causes: The binary progress proxy gives equal total credit to an empty-cell insertion and any strictly positive local replacement, without weighting replacement magnitude or whether the event advances the global terminal Top-1. The Candidate recorded 38 insertions and 322 replacements, yet its seed-0 macro score was 0.305531766468484 versus the Parent's 0.433980299268775 and its final Top-1 was lower on all five tasks. This is consistent with frequent local archive progress being weakly aligned with the benchmark objective, although one stochastic replica cannot isolate that explanation.

The smoothed rate is cumulative over the full objective session, so an initially productive cell can remain favored after its local neighborhood is exhausted and a temporarily unproductive cell can remain underweighted after its prospects change. The logs establish persistent rate separation and positive allocation lift, but contain no counterfactual or temporal-predictiveness test showing that past binary progress predicts the next round's progress.

Only screening seed 0 was evaluated. Weighted selection changes the seeded parent-draw path and therefore the downstream graph trajectory; the observed terminal regression may reflect a sparse delayed-payoff path missed by this replica, ordinary trajectory variance, or systematic proxy misalignment, which this activation analysis cannot distinguish.

Different occupied cells develop distinguishable descendant progress rates early enough in the 29 adaptive rounds for feedback-weighted allocation to affect later proposals.

Recent cumulative source-cell productivity is informative about future empty-cell insertions or positive local replacements under the unchanged graph operators; benefit may vanish when all niches are equally productive or productivity reverses faster than the smoothed counts can adapt.

Useful objective progress is correlated with continued archive coverage or strict within-cell improvement, rather than requiring repeated failures from a currently unproductive niche before a rare structural jump.

The fixed 0.5 uniform mixture is sufficient to keep low-history and lower-global-rank cell elites reachable; the mechanism may underperform when nearly uniform allocation is itself necessary to discover a very sparse delayed-payoff path.

The Parent's high canonical novel-valid graph-offspring yield and frozen descriptor assignment continue to hold, because this Child changes allocation among existing cell elites rather than candidate support or niche definitions.
Evidence for the bottleneck is limited to screening seed 0, so multi-seed stability and whether allocation lift mediates a reliable score gain remain to be established by the protocol evaluation.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism did not happen if any post-feedback draw with non-identical smoothed source-cell progress rates fails to use probabilities reproducibly equal to 0.5/K+0.5*q_i/sum_j(q_j), if its archive-progress-weighted allocation lift is non-positive, or if any occupied cell receives less than half its uniform-reference probability. If source-cell histories never become non-identical, activation is inconclusive because the feedback signal supplied no basis to depart from the Parent's uniform policy.
research_intent.implementation_change: Preserve the Parent's frozen CVT artifact and assignment, one-incumbent-per-cell archive, strict target-cell-only replacement, graph crossover and mutation portfolio, canonicalization and duplicate rejection, accepted-feedback matching, full-batch requirement, and all session boundaries. Add fresh per-objective fractional trial and archive-progress credit totals keyed only by source cell. For each accepted offspring, split one trial equally across its distinct provenance parent cells and, if its recorded decision is empty_insert or replace_higher, split one binary progress credit equally across those same cells; rejected local competitors contribute a trial and zero credit. Before each parent draw over K occupied cells, compute q_i=(credit_i+1)/(trial_i+2), including q_i=1/2 for a newly occupied cell, and declare p_i=0.5/K+0.5*q_i/sum_j(q_j); sample once from those probabilities with the existing seeded RNG. Log the complete pre-draw trial, credit, q_i, uniform reference, p_i, selected cell, and the feedback events that update credit. Do not use global score rank, remove any archive member, alter graph generation, or transfer credit between objective sessions.
research_intent.mechanism: Replace only uniform occupied-cell parent sampling with archive-progress-weighted sampling: give each source cell task-local binary credit when an evaluated descendant inserts into an empty cell or strictly improves an occupied cell, then mix its smoothed empirical progress rate with a fixed uniform exploration component so productive cells receive more parent draws while every occupied cell remains eligible.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Parent node n-9ee8f4c3d8e6 makes every one of its 2,207 occupied-cell parent draws exactly uniform, so its selection policy cannot use accumulated evidence that some descriptor cells' descendants are currently more productive than others. The emitter is not the limiting behavior: it produced 1,450 novel valid proposals from 1,503 graph-operator attempts and filled every batch, while the archive reached 76 of 80 task-local cells. Yet only 332 of 1,409 occupied-cell collisions made a strictly positive local replacement, 1,077 were rejected as non-higher, and the seed-0 final Top-1 values remained 0.1895644065926511 on median_2 and 0.21007735497596944 on sitagliptin_mpo. With only 29 adaptive rounds, continuing to allocate equal probability after source-cell outcomes diverge can spend late oracle calls on repeatedly unproductive niches instead of exploiting niches that are still creating coverage or local-quality progress.
